rules.logic: ABIOC(KOI-009 IDE Extension Host Spawns Scripting Host For First Seen Publisher) FOLLOWED_BY BIOC(KOI-009 Keychain Access By IDE Descendant) FOLLOWED_BY BIOC(KOI-009 LaunchAgent Written And Loaded From IDE Lineage) FOLLOWED_BY BIOC(KOI-009 Multi Credential File Read Under IDE CGO) FOLLOWED_BY XQL(KOI-009 Staging Directory Created Under IDE Lineage) — all stitched by shared agent_hostname and causality_id (CGO = the VS Code IDE) so the activation-time scripting host, Keychain access, LaunchAgent persistence, credential read and local staging collapse into ONE GlassWorm incident. The chain closes on the endpoint: its terminal term is the staging-directory create, not the egress, so the rule fires in a lab with no authorised sink and no firewall in path.
rules.name: GlassWorm macOS Wave — Extension Host Scripting, Keychain, LaunchAgent, Credential Read and Local Staging
